_note: The framework's tunables (src/coach/analyze, src/coach/report/format.ts, src/coach/report/prioritize.ts, src/coach/detect/common.ts). docs/coach/report.md 'Prioritizer'.

prioritizer._: priority = impact × confidence × fixability × recurrence (src/coach/report/prioritize.ts). Effective confidence = the finding's × (1 − exp(−instances / instanceScale)). A fix leads only above the bar: evidence, effective confidence ≥ minConfidence, impact ≥ minImpact (fights per 24 rounds) and priority ≥ minPriority. Up to maxFixes, one per scope first, never two of one root family. The lobby excess needs minLobby other players with a value. Strengths: max(impact, strengthFloor) × confidence, up to maxStrengths. Recurrence = min(recurrenceMax, 1 + recurrenceStep × earlier matches with the family).

fixability._: How quickly a player can fix the habit, 0–1 (longest matching detector id or finding-id prefix; default for the rest). Habits of the hands and keys are quick (counter-strafe, reloads, weapon out); buys are a decision before the round; utility needs lineups; aim and positioning are slow skills.

families._: Root causes: findings of one family never both lead. Detectors not listed are their own family.

baseline._: Detectors whose impact counts every instance (not the excess over the lobby): their impact is scaled by the lobby excess of the finding's first metric. The aim detectors and pos.opening.losing already measure against the lobby or an even split.

gate._: Detectors whose precision K11 measured below minPrecision on the review set can only produce observations. measured: detector id → measured precision (none measured yet; the precisions in the area files are assumptions and do not gate).

confidence._: Sample-size factor: 1 − exp(−n / nScale), where each detector gives its own nScale in its area file; strengths also need rank ≤ strengthMaxRank among at least strengthMinLobby players with a value.

clock._: Round clock for finding texts: roundSec from the freeze end; after the plant the bomb timer (bombSec).
